meta.source: AEC Transparency Register returns (annual, election, referendum) via parli.db `donations` table
meta.methodology: Donor->party flows from rows with a canonical party recipient; amounts aggregated per (canonical donor entity, party) using ext_donor_aliases, so every spelling of a donor counts once. Top 250 donors by lifetime total shown, plus donors under that cut-off holding $50,000,000+ in Commonwealth contracts and grants.
meta.entity_resolution: parli.ingest.donor_entities resolves each raw donor_name to an entity in ext_donor_entities (exact-normalised, rule-based suffix/branch stripping, then the hand-curated parli/ingest/donor_aliases.json). Node label is the canonical name; node.aliases lists the other spellings it answers to.
meta.year_derivation: financial_year is the AEC event name on election returns; the first 4-digit year is used, and named by-elections fall back to their polling year (Braddon/Wentworth 2018, Eden-Monaro 2020, Fadden 2023).
meta.by_year: byYear maps the first year of each financial year (2023 for 2023-24; election returns by polling year) to [dollars, donations] for that node or flow; undated holds the rows with no year. The cells sum to total and count up to rounding, so a year window can re-sum every figure.
exclusions: rows not from the AEC Transparency Register (a third-party copy of AEC annual returns; Queensland ECQ state disclosures, shown on money.qld.json)
rows without a canonical party recipient (receipts of unions/associated entities)
public electoral funding (AEC / state electoral commissions / ATO / Dept of Finance)
donor entities resolved to kind='government' or kind='party_unit'
internal party transfers (industry='party_internal' or donor named after a party), from donor totals and flows only; party node totals include them
donors with industry other/unknown under $5m lifetime
meta.public_money_note: donors_via_public_money are under the top-250 donation cut-off but hold at least $50,000,000 in Commonwealth contracts and grants resolved to the same entity; node.via = 'public_money' and node.publicMoney say so.
meta.grants_source: GrantConnect grant awards (Department of Finance), CC BY 3.0 AU
meta.grants_note: Grant flows run from the grantor node out to the donors on this map that the grant register resolves to the same entity (parli.ingest.grant_recipients: ABN, then unique name). They are public money going the other way and are never summed with donations; node totals stay donations only. byYear keys are the first year of the financial year the grant started.
meta.contracts_source: AusTender contract notices (Department of Finance), CC BY 3.0 AU; a varied contract counts once, at its latest notice's value
meta.contracts_note: Contract flows run from the Commonwealth contracts hub out to the donors on this map that the supplier register resolves to the same entity (parli.ingest.contract_suppliers: ABN, then name). Public money going the other way, never summed with donations; byYear keys are the first year of the financial year the contract started.
meta.associated_entities: Rule 9: a donor the AEC associated-entity register lists as an associated entity of a party it gives to (any branch or division of it) is flagged, not moved: node.associatedWith and node.associatedTag; receipts, totals, flows and rank are unchanged. The same rule applies to every party.
meta.party_totals_note: Party node totals cover all cleaned AEC rows assigned to a party except public funding identified by the reported donor name and payments by entities the resolver knows as government bodies; unlike donor totals and flows, they include internal party transfers.

receipt_types.measure: Recipient-side itemised receipts only. Donor-side declarations are cross-checks, never added. Equal rows within a recipient file are retained as disclosed.
receipt_types.legacy_totals: total, count and byYear are unchanged legacy all-record aggregates. They include donor declarations and must not be used as the typed receipt measure.
receipt_types.fields: by_type contains AUD amounts; by_type_year maps financial year (short form) or election/referendum event to type: [AUD, row count]. Node cells sum visible receipt edges only, unlike legacy party node totals.
receipt_types.normalisation: AEC labels lowercased, punctuation/whitespace replaced with underscores. Donation Received = donation_received. Blank = unknown. Unspecified remains unspecified. No inference of loans from Other Receipt.
receipt_types.scope: Political Party Return recipients with an exact unambiguous existing party mapping, and donor-party edges on this map. Other recipient kinds remain in aec_receipt_records. This is a capped donor map, not all AEC receipts.
receipt_types.selection: aec_receipt_selection.ReceiptSelection.exclusion is shared with the uncapped report: recipient-side positive itemised party receipts, exact recipient mapping, no reviewed outliers, government/party-unit entities or public-funding/party-name donor spellings. Map edge membership is the additional cap.
receipt_types.party_return_note: return_by_type and return_by_type_year on a federal party node count the itemised receipts in the party's own annual returns (AEC Detailed Receipts, Political Party Return), each receipt line once and all receipt types, so a gift the donor also declared is never added twice. A return is counted under the party its name reads as when that party is on the map, otherwise under the existing recipient mapping (so Country Labor Party is counted with Labor and Country Liberal Party (NT) on its own, as the AEC's Party Group has them). Left out: public funding (receipt type Public Funding, a public-funding or government payer name, or a payer the resolver knows as a government body), flagged data-quality outliers, blank or non-positive lines, and transfers within the party. A line is a transfer within the party only if the payer's own returns are counted in the same node: the payer is a party unit, the same rule places it in this node, and it is not on the AEC associated-entity register. That money was counted when the paying branch received it, so it is left out rather than keyed; party_return_transfers gives it per party as [AUD, lines]. A payer whose returns are counted in another node, or in none, is counted as a receipt, as are associated entities. Amounts under the disclosure threshold are not itemised by the AEC and are not here, so these figures are well below the AEC's Total Receipts. A node with no counted line has no return fields. Unlike the legacy total, count and byYear, these fields hold no donor-side declarations; unlike by_type on a party node, they are not capped to donors drawn on the map.
